description: Returns the latest known state of one APRS station by callsign: last heard time, last reported position (WGS84 latitude/longitude), altitude (m), speed (km/h), course (degrees), station type, symbol, comment, digipeater path, device model when identifiable, packet count and first-heard time. Answers questions such as where an amateur-radio callsign is, whether it is on the air, or what it beacons. If the callsign has no exact match, the most recently heard SSID of the same operator is returned. Read-only; data is public APRS-IS traffic.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.
